class: A fallback that depended on a package never installed, and choices the owner could not make
symptom: OpenAI was listed as the last resume writer but could never write one (the openai package was not installed); OpenAI could not answer forms at all; and who answered and who wrote was a fixed order the owner could not change from the dashboard.
root_cause: OpenAIDocumentClient imported the openai SDK at call time and failed quietly into the next provider; answering was wired to Gemini or Claude only; the writer order was hard-coded in config.available_tailor_providers.
why_tests_missed: No test exercised the OpenAI path end to end; the provider order was only ever tested as Claude-first.
fix: openai_integration speaks the Chat Completions API over plain HTTPS and can answer forms (OpenAIClient) or write (OpenAIDocumentClient). ai_choice.py holds both of the owner's choices -- FORM_ANSWER_MODE with each provider's model ladders, and RESUME_WRITER / RESUME_WRITER_FALLBACK -- set on Settings from model lists each provider gives for the key (ai_models.py). Claude's answers climb a ladder too (claude_answers.py), and every provider shares model_ladder.py.
prevention: Every provider path has a test that sends a request through it, dependencies are declared and checked at start, and choices that cost the owner money are made by the owner, in the interface.
